title: BrowserPilot AI
overview: BrowserPilot AI is an autonomous web agent that navigates the internet, parses complex DOM structures, and extracts relevant information or performs actions on behalf of the user.
problem: Navigating complex and dynamic web pages programmatically is difficult and prone to breaking when DOM structures change.
solution: Developed a resilient, AI-driven engine using Gemini to visually and semantically understand page layouts instead of relying on hardcoded CSS selectors.
architecture: Next.js frontend communicating with a Node.js backend running Playwright, orchestrated by the Gemini API for decision making.
challenges: Handling CAPTCHAs and dynamically loaded React/Vue SPA content required advanced waiting strategies and visual fallback mechanisms.
lessonsLearned: Deepened understanding of headless browser performance optimization and LLM prompt engineering for structural data extraction.
futureImprovements: Adding support for multi-step authenticated workflows and a visual node-based scenario builder.
